title: Asraafo a Dɔte a Ɛtu Sohyiaa Wɔn
intro: Wɔ bere a edii Ɔkɔmhyɛni Muhammad anim no, sodifo bi a ɔwɔ tumi a ofi Yemen fii asraafo ɔsatu bi ase a na n’atirimpɔw ne sɛ ɔbɛsɛe kronkronbea kronkron bi a ɛwɔ Makkah. Saa ɔtamfo yi dii asraafo dɔm kɛse bi a ɔko asono ayɛ wɔn ma, a na wɔwɔ ahotoso wɔ wɔn ahoɔden ne wɔn dodow mu no anim. Nanso, na wɔn akwantu no bɛba awiei mpofirim bere a wohyia ɔsoro de ne ho gyee mu a wɔnhwɛ kwan no. So wubetumi ahu onii a ohyiaa saa akontaabu a ɛyɛ nwonwa yi?
clues: Yɛne asraafo dɔm kɛse ne ɔko asono a wɔn ho yɛ den nantew kɔɔ ofie kronkron no ho
Yɛbɔɔ yɛn tirim sɛ yebetutu na yɛasɛe beae bi a wɔsom wɔ Mmɔborohunufo a Mmoborohunufo no asomfo kyekyee
Wɔsomaa nnomaa nketewa kuw bi baa yɛn so, na wokurakura dɔte abo wɔ wɔn ano ne wɔn nsateaa mu
Wɔde nnyigyei bi a ɛtow abo guu yɛn so, na ɛdanee yɛn nkaefo a wɔatiatia yɛn so no hyiaa yɛn
Na mefiri Yemen asase so na mesom wɔ sodifoɔ bi a ɔhwehwɛɛ sɛ ɔbɛ挑衅 kronkronbea kronkron no ase
Wɔyɛɛ yɛn nhwɛsoɔ maa wɔn a wɔbɛnya akokoɔduro de desafío Allah kronkronbea no

trial.label: Sɔhwɛ/Asɛm a esii
options: Anhweatam so abankɛse bi a wɔaka ahyɛ mu
Ntua a wɔde baa kronkronbea kronkron a ɛwɔ Makkah no so
Po so akodi a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ po so
Atuatew a wɔde tia ɔhene otirimɔdenfo bi
Odiyifo bi a wayera a wɔhwehwɛ
trial.answer: Ntua a wɔde baa kronkronbea kronkron a ɛwɔ Makkah no so

location.label: Ade Titiriw
options: Mina bon a ɛbɛn Makkah no
location.answer: Mina bon a ɛbɛn Makkah no

outcome.label: Nsunsuansoɔ
options: Nkonimdi ne ofie kronkron no sɛe
Nnomaa a wɔso dɔte abo di nkogu
San w’akyi esiane osu a ɛtɔ kɛse nti
outcome.answer: Nnomaa a wɔso dɔte abo di nkogu

verse: Did He not make their plan into misguidance? (105:2-4)
